newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Fenton to proceed with BIL stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Fenton to proceed with BIL stake sale.

text.p: Fenton Assets Ltd will sell its 20.1 percent stake in New Zealand's Brierley Investments Ltd (BIL) following a Malaysian Securities Commission ruling on the matter, Haw Par Brothers International said on Wednesday.
Haw Par's 20 percent associate, Camerlin, holds 60 percent of Fenton.

Haw Par said in a statement that the Securities Commission of Malaysia had not approved a price of seven ringitt each for new shares in Malex Industries Bhd to be issued in consideration for the proposed acquisition of the BIL stake.

Fenton has agreed to accept the decision and proceed with sale to Malex of 539.4 million shares and 63.7 million convertible notes, or 20.1 percent of BIL, for a total consideration of 1.4 billion ringgit.
The price would be met by 710.3 million ringgit in cash and by the issue of 88.8 million new Malex shares at eight ringgit each.
Aside from Haw Par, Camerlin's other shareholders include the Hong Leong group, First Capital Corp, and SembCorp.
The proposed transaction is not expected to have any impact on Haw Par's earnings per share for the current financial year ending December 31, 1997, the statement said.
